    EgradxOrganizationMembershipEntity
    The row that actually answers "what role does this user have in this organization" — a user can belong to several organizations, but this table's (userId, organizationId) unique constraint enforces exactly one role per organization per user.
    EgradxPasswordResetEntity
    An outstanding password-reset link.
    EgradxRefreshTokenEntity
    An opaque refresh token — a random string, not a JWT (nothing about it needs to be self-verifying; its validity is entirely "does a non-expired, non-revoked row with this token value exist").
    EgradxRoleEntity
    A named bundle of authorities — this is the unit an admin assigns to a user, but it is never the unit an access check is written against and it is never what ends up in an issued token.
    EgradxUserContactEntity
    One way to reach a person: an address on a channel — an email address, a phone number for SMS or WhatsApp, a Slack member id.
